notes_for_editor: District conflict: Firelookout gives Nipissing District (unorganized South Nipissing); the Canada Lookouts index gives Parry Sound District, Bonfield; the fan list says only Bonfield. The record's local_unit should be checked against township boundaries before settling it; no correction proposed yet. Status conflict: the record says it no longer appears on North Bay topographic map 31L, which does not show whether it stands; the fan list's asterisk (cupola removed, now communications use) is undated. Neither confirms current standing. The 100 ft figure is the 1963 map as the record describes it, so height_m 30.5 is a conversion of a tower height, not a measured cab-floor height. The Ontario LIO tower dataset in cache has no Boulter point. The 1963 map PDF in data/raw/expansion/on/FireTowers_1963_map.pdf is image-only and was not quoted. The fan list's original oocities URL now returns 404; the cited copy is the geocities.ws archive. Build year, staffing and fires are unsourced and left out of the story.
